claimed_scope: Implement the Frankenstein-2.0 canonical UnifiedDB resolver and deterministic database fingerprint primitive. Preserve one durable-state authority, bind path resolution to explicit provenance, and make the fingerprint describe the exact selected SQLite file and schema identity without reading semantic row contents. No donor behavior, runtime integration, GRID10, HCU, EntityOS, VPS, whole-system or cognition credit is minted by this claim.
non_overlap_note: Phase-0 provenance/run-package/telemetry work has active or completed parallel claims. This claim is limited to F2-WP-100 and does not modify those implementations or the Frankenstein 1.x read-only donor.
acceptance_target: one deterministic resolver with explicit selection provenance and no silent package-tree fallback
pointer/env/XDG/legacy resolution is testable without touching a live user database
canonical fingerprint binds resolved path, file size, SHA-256, SQLite header/version metadata and deterministic schema digest
fingerprint fails closed for missing/non-SQLite/corrupt database inputs
tests cover precedence, stale-pointer fallback, fresh-install XDG destination and fingerprint drift
source/component tests do not imply F2 runtime acceptance
next_exact_action: Add the F2-native UnifiedDB resolver/fingerprint module and deterministic unit tests, run them in an isolated local source-test environment, then persist bounded source/component evidence.
